Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 한 번 더 훈련에 도전하겠다고 말한다. 어떻게 할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wants to attempt the training once more. What should I say?

Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> möchte das Training noch einmal versuchen. Was tun?

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quer tentar o treinamento mais uma vez. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> บอกว่าจะลองฝึกซ้อมดูอีกสักครั้ง จะเอายังไงดี?

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> muốn thử thách tập luyện thêm một lần nữa. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> एक बार फिर प्रशिक्षण का प्रयास करना चाहती है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: No, let's call it a day.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: いや、今日はもう休もう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 不了，今天先到此为止吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 不了，今天先到此為止吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nein, lass uns für heute Schluss machen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไม่ค่ะ วันนี้พอแค่นี้เถอะค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Tidak, mari kita akhiri hari ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: नहीं, आज के लिए बस इतना ही।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then how about one more round?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: じゃあ、もう一度やってみる？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Alors, on essaie encore une fois ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wie wäre es dann mit einer weiteren Runde?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¿Qué tal si lo intentamos una vez más?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Então, que tal mais uma rodada?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: งั้นลองอีกครั้งไหมคะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kalau begitu, bagaimana kalau satu putaran lagi?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy thử thêm một lần nữa nhé?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तो एक और दौर के बारे में क्या ख्याल है?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาเพิ่มพลังให้ค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một lọ Thuốc Sinh Lực.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि दी जाती है।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.

Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को अभी भी असंतोष महसूस हो रहा था।

Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
